source: I want to make a 3D game where a team of ice people defend their ice town with a grey wall while a team of players with torches rush to break down the ice people's defenses and melt the city.

image_prompt.text: The ice town at the centre of the map, the structure the defending side is protecting
A grey defensive wall ringing the ice town that the attacking side can break down
High wall sections and icy buildings blocking specific angles of approach so no single attack line dominates
Defender and attacker starting areas set back and screened, defenders inside the wall and attackers out on the open approach
A compact cluster of icy buildings and narrow icy streets inside the wall

layout_placement.text: The ice town as the defending side primary health pool, lost when it is melted
The point on the open approach where the attacking side enters the map
Two team spawns, ice defenders behind the wall and torch carriers outside it, neither appearing in the other line of attack
Ice structures that melt away under torch fire rather than fracturing

notes: The attackers are a team of players rather than NPC waves, so the preset wave-origin spawner is being reused as the attacker entry point.
Melting is a state change over the ice geometry; no loaded option expresses it and breakable cover is not the same thing.
Action was loaded as a secondary genre only for the two-team spawn option, which Strategy has no equivalent of.

open_questions.ask: How does a round end - a timer the defenders survive, or the whole town melted?
Is the town a handful of buildings or a full settlement inside the wall?

theme: Frozen ice town with a grey stone wall

coverage_missing.ask: What ends the round - defenders surviving a timer, or the town being fully melted?
How many players per side, and is it even or attacker-heavy?

answers.ask: How does a round end - a timer the defenders survive, or the whole town melted?
answers.answer: A round ends when the attackers melt the whole town; the ice team wins if they keep any of the town standing until the round timer expires.

answers.ask: Is the town a handful of buildings or a full settlement inside the wall?
answers.answer: Make it a small town with a handful of ice buildings inside the grey wall, so the match area stays compact and playable.
